description: Search BeeDirectory for newsletters to sponsor. Returns newsletters whose numbers have a source (verified via the beehiiv API or a public page, or published by the owner), with subscribers, open rate, sponsorship price per send, price per 1,000 subscribers, rate card and the listing URL. Verified newsletters come first.

query.description: Keywords matched against name and description, e.g. 'productivity' or 'devtools'

verifiedOnly.description: Only newsletters whose audience is verified

name: search_newsletters
title: Search newsletters to sponsor
